scope: Crystal pinned ff7ede5 and00ce02a5 complete items.xml + all10 files under data/scripts/weapons; selected parser/weapon/player/combat consumers. Canary admitted47df corroborating selected files/items.xml. No repo edits/Cargo/Tavily/publish.
source_role: OtsHypothesisOnly; exact upstream implementation evidence, not official Tibia per-Item product truth

findings.finding: XML shootType maps to ItemType.shootType and drives Distance/Wand params.distanceEffect. ff7 has83 weapon declaration rows excluding ammunition (15distance+68wand), plus29 explicit ammunition rows and2 lacking weaponType (diamond arrow25757,royal star25759), total114 XML declarations with shootType. Untyped rows require actual script/binding identity bridge.

ff7 XML has22 meleeAttackEffect item rows, all declare fist. Sai10389 monkdaggers and drachaku10391 monkstaff. Parser accepts explicit effect tokens; C++ gives explicit item override priority then type default.
ff7 XML effect60 rows contain no weaponType declaration; examples water/lava. Must not report60 weapon attack effects. XML keys containing sound count0 at both pinned Crystal versions.

Diamond arrow25757/35901 registered explicitly: ENERGYHIT impact, DIAMONDARROW projectile, diamond impact sound and bow cast sound. Burst arrow similarly registers3449/22119. Script effects belong to onUseWeapon combat context; mapping needs literal registration/full binding, not filename/name inference.

Player attack sound switch derives axe/sword/club/fist,bow/crossbow/throw,magical from current weapon/ammo; hit sound switch selects projectile-aware burst/diamond sound plus ordinary ranged/wand values. Weapon dispatch sends these if params.soundCastEffect SILENCE, otherwise sends explicit combat sound pair.
Combat chain effects/sounds selected by type/element in setupChain and Item movement sound by category/material are separate event contexts; do not silently promote as intrinsic item attack media.

function diamondArrow.onUseWeapon(player, variant)

end
